description:
Title: App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run

If you want to participate at the Vienna Night Run, you need to select a starting block first.
After that, you run for 5km and measure the time.
If you can do it in less than 25 minutes, you are good.
If not, you need to train and check until you have achieved this goal.
After that, you can get your starting number.
Depending on when your work day ends, you have to find out whether you can go there from home, or need to leave directly from work.
If more than one hour is left between your starting time and the end of your workday, you can go there from home.
Else, you need to leave directly from work.
While running at the Night Run, you run and drink at the same time.
In the end, you receive your final running time.

Some of the above information you have to enter into the app, some of the information is collected by fitness gadgets.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Participant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Participant" name="Participant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunAndMeasure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeGoal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Train</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineDeparture</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DepartureChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DepartureMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunAndDrink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin participation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterInformation" name="Enter information into the app"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select a starting block"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunAndMeasure" name="Run 5 km and measure the time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeGoal" name="Less than 25 minutes?" default="Flow_TimeGoal_No"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Train" name="Train"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get the starting number"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineDeparture" name="Find out whether to go from home or leave from work"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DepartureChoice" name="More than one hour between the starting time and the end of the workday?" default="Flow_Choice_Work"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to the Night Run from home"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DepartureMerge" name="Merge departure alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunAndDrink" name="Run and drink at the same time at the Night Run"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived" name="Receive the final running time"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Begin_Enter" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_EnterInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Select" sourceRef="Task_EnterInformation" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Run" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Task_RunAndMeasure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_Goal" sourceRef="Task_RunAndMeasure" targetRef="Gateway_TimeGoal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimeGoal_Yes" name="Less than 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeGoal" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">measuredTime < PT25M</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimeGoal_No" name="25 minutes or more" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeGoal" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Train_Check" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Task_RunAndMeasure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Number_Determine" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_DetermineDeparture"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Determine_Choice" sourceRef="Task_DetermineDeparture" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Home" name="More than one hour" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureChoice" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">timeBetweenStartingTimeAndWorkdayEnd > PT1H</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choice_Work" name="One hour or less" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureChoice" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Home_Merge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Work_Merge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge" targetRef="Task_RunAndDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_End" sourceRef="Task_RunAndDrink" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_FitnessGadgets">
      <bpmn:text>Some information is collected by fitness gadgets.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
